content:
- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (positive sentiment > 0.10) — reduce forecast peak by 3–5% relative to sentiment strength.
- Underestimate prices after strong negative sentiment spikes (sentiment < -0.20) — add 2–4% buffer to avoid underreaction.
- Forecast tends to lag 1–2 days in upward moves — adjust forward by 0.5–1.0 price unit for early sentiment-driven rallies.
- Overshoots after sharp price spikes — cap forecast at 1.5x the immediate prior peak unless sentiment confirms continuation.
- Mean reversion bias: if 3 consecutive days show >1% upward movement, reduce forecast slope by 10–15% to avoid overbought trap.
- Sentiment reversal (positive → negative or vice versa) triggers 1–2 day price correction — adjust forecast downward 1–2% for 2 days post-reversal.
